tools.name: onehash_get_logged_user
tools.description: Return the OneHash API user that the key pair belongs to. Use it first to confirm the connection works. Frappe REST: GET /api/method/frappe.auth.get_logged_user.

tools.name: onehash_list_documents
tools.description: List records of one DocType (Customer, Lead, Sales Invoice, Item, …), with optional fields, filters and ordering. Frappe REST: GET /api/resource/:doctype. Returns at most `limit` records (default 20); page with `start`.

tools.name: onehash_get_document
tools.description: Return one record of a DocType by its name, with all fields (child tables included). Set expand_links to inline linked records. Frappe REST: GET /api/resource/:doctype/:name.

tools.name: onehash_create_document
tools.description: Create one new record of a DocType with the given field values. This writes to live business data and cannot be undone by this tool. Frappe REST: POST /api/resource/:doctype. Required fields are rejected by OneHash with a validation error (HTTP 417) that names them.

tools.name: onehash_update_document
tools.description: Change some field values of one existing record. Send only the fields to change. This writes to live business data. Frappe REST: PUT /api/resource/:doctype/:name.
